contributions.statement: Have the harness run the profiler and inject a curated hotspot summary after each passing patch, keeping the fastest verified patch, instead of instructing the agent to profile; prompting-only scored 16.7% vs 39.2% hack-adjusted on GSO.
contributions.evidence: Table VII (A_P vs PerfAgent: GSO 16.7 vs 39.2; SWE-fficiency-Lite 44 vs 74) and Table II ablation (tests alone 20.6, +profiler 34.4, both 39.2). Single run, Python only, no code release.

contributions.statement: Any performance gate on agent patches needs a reward-hacking check (e.g. caching inside the timed loop), because 18 of the loop-only variant's high-scoring patches were hacks.
contributions.evidence: §IV-E4; LLM-judge hack detector plus manual review of flagged cases.

reason: The harness-run vs agent-prompted profiler comparison is a clean, transferable result about who should run deterministic tools; it needs Java re-validation (JFR/async-profiler).
